title: Marlowe & Finch Alterations Workroom Pricing Clause: Lining Charge on Added Work
content:
**Clause.** On a lined garment's Marlowe & Finch Alterations ticket, the lined surcharge owed for an operation added after the drop-off date is priced as follows.

1. **The operation charge it is priced on.** The lined surcharge for added work is priced on the most recently booked operation charge on the ticket — the operation charge with the latest booking date, and the higher one where several share that latest date. The booking date of that charge is the date the operation was booked. A ticket with no operation charge owes none.
2. **Class.** In a class whose lined-garment surcharge percentage is 0, nothing is owed.
3. **Amount.** The lined surcharge for added work is the lined-work basis multiplied by one hundred less the member, recent-purchase and ticket-size lining discounts, divided by one hundred, rounded half up to the cent once at the end. On this clause the lined-work basis is the class's lined-garment surcharge percentage of that operation charge, and no discount applies, so the surcharge is that percentage of the charge, rounded half up to the cent.

**Rounding.** Half up to the cent: a figure at or above the half-cent mark, or within 0.0001 of a cent below it, goes up to the next cent.

## Worked example (hypothetical figures)

A lined dress in a class whose lined-garment surcharge percentage is, for this example, 20 percent. Operation charges on the ticket:

| Operation charge | Booked |
|---|---|
| 18.00 USD | on the drop-off date |
| 28.00 USD | four days after drop-off |
| 34.00 USD | four days after drop-off |

The latest booking date is shared by 28.00 and 34.00 USD; the higher, 34.00 USD, is the charge the surcharge is priced on. The lined surcharge is 20 percent of 34.00 USD, that is 6.80 USD.

**Rounding (hypothetical).** At 25 percent, an operation charge of 32.50 USD gives 8.125 USD, which rounds to 8.13 USD.
